materials.authoringNotes: Layered paint, subtle patch repairs, rain streaking and dust deposits; avoid uniform procedural noise.
Formwork variation, aggregate scale appropriate to viewing distance, restrained edge wear.
Physically plausible tint and roughness; no fake mirror reflections.
Painted metal with localized chips and oxidation; metallic values belong to exposed metal, not paint.
Subtle corrugation and weathering, low-frequency variation.
Directional grain, sun fading and edge wear.
Scale-correct tiles and joints, used selectively.
Fine aggregate and patch variation; keep normal intensity low for mobile readability.

note: Eight surface families remain the district-wide authoring contract. The first hero pilot now contains embedded 2K CC0 PBR data from three real source materials, compressed as KTX2/Basis. Do not treat the remaining 47 Stage 08E assets or the unimplemented material families as upgraded.
